message.content: {"draft":"Hypothesis: small shapes are launch-bound; torch.compile wins on 4099. Contradiction: candidate 0.892 vs compiled 0.891 us. Fix: use larger BLOCK_SIZE (1024) to reduce grid/launch overhead for small n. Coordinate check: flat offset i maps to x[i],y[i],out[i]; edge i=4098 valid, i=4099 masked.","plan":"Padded lanes load 0 via mask; actual width n; mask offsets<n on load/store. Cast to fp32, add, cast to output dtype. Allocate fresh contiguous empty_like. Use BLOCK_SIZE=1024 for all sizes to minimize grid. Verify 4099: 4 blocks, last block masked at 4096-4098.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def add_kernel(x_ptr, y_ptr, output_ptr, n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):","    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)","    offsets = pid * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = offsets < n_elements","    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offsets, mask=mask).to(tl.float32)","    y = tl.load(y_ptr + offsets, mask=mask).to(tl.float32)","    out = (x + y).to(output_ptr.dtype.element_ty)","    tl.store(output_ptr + offsets, out, mask=mask)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and y.is_cuda","    assert x.shape == y.shape","    assert x.dtype in (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16)","    assert x.is_contiguous() and y.is_contiguous()","    output = torch.empty_like(x)","    n_elements = x.numel()","    BLOCK_SIZE = 1024","    grid = lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(n_elements, meta['BLOCK_SIZE']),)","    add_kernel[grid](x, y, output, n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE)","    return output"]}
